**Issue #1989 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1989: Patch: who takes the first turn of an online match is the match seed's coin, not who queued first or who hosts, and a rematch swaps the seats
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Today the first turn of an online game always goes to the same side: whoever joined the queue first, whoever made the room, and in a rematch the same player as last time, game after game. Against a ladder bot the person always goes first. After this, a coin drawn from each match's seed decides who goes first, the same coin every replay draws, and a rematch hands the first turn to the other player. Nobody can choose the first turn any more by queueing early or by hosting. The ladder bots also start playing from the first seat, so their ratings stop being measured from one seat only.

## Why

The spec gives the first turn to Player 1 (§2.1 step 5). The server always seats the same person there:

- **Queue.** `try_pair` sorts the open tickets oldest first (`crates/server/src/api/queue.rs:668`). The outer ticket `a` becomes `PlayerId::P1` (`queue.rs:759`, `start_paired_match` at `:553-571`). §9.5 states it: "between two people the older ticket is Player 1".
- **Rooms.** The host is always P1 (`crates/server/src/actor/rooms.rs:241-279`).
- **Rematches.** `finished.players.0` is P1 again (`crates/server/src/api/rematch.rs:224-243`). That includes double-or-nothing, which doubles the rating move (R672).
- **Bots.** R1453 seats the person as P1 every time. It rejected a coin because a coin "would put a lone player second half the time, which no pairing with a person does". That reason is only consistency with the older-ticket rule; a coin for every pairing removes it.
- **Conquest.** R335 makes the player who queued first, or hosted, the series' p1, who goes first in the odd games. So a three-game series also leans the same way.

The seat matters to the owner. R1156000 raised Player 1's opening draw "for seat balance" (issue #1156). R335 alternates series games so the first seat is not "a prize". Live ladder-bot ratings (R610) are fitted only on games where the bot sits second. The offline calibration, by contrast, alternates seats (`docs/bot-calibration.md:29-30`).

## Proposal

- Draw the seats from the match seed on a stream of their own, with a named label as `dealt_deck`'s seat deals have. This applies at every 1v1 door: queue pairs (Best of 1 and All Random), room joins and bot pairings.
- A rematch swaps the seats of the match it follows.
- A Conquest series draws its p1 by the same coin and keeps R335's alternation.
- End-to-end runs get a seat override beside R143's seed override, so the seeded e2e specs keep the seats they were written for.
- A new ruling in the issue's own block amends R1453, R335 and §9.5.

## Where it lands

- `crates/server/src/api/queue.rs`, `crates/server/src/actor/rooms.rs`, `crates/server/src/api/rematch.rs`, the bot pairing path (`crates/server/src/bots/`) and the series start (`crates/server/src/api/series*.rs`)
- `crates/server/src/config.rs` (the stream's label)
- The server tests that assume host or older ticket is P1, and the seeded e2e room specs
- `spec/09-architecture.md` §9.5 and §9.12, `spec/rulings/R1453.md`, `spec/rulings/R0335.md`, a new ruling note, `spec/INDEX.md`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Over a fixed set of seeds, a queue pair, a room and a bot pairing each produce both seat orders, and the same seed always gives the same seats.
- [ ] A rematch (and a double-or-nothing) seats the previous match's P2 as P1.
- [ ] A Conquest series' first game follows the coin and its games still alternate (R335's tests, amended).
- [ ] Each e2e spec seats as it was written, through the end-to-end override.
- [ ] A new match's replay folds to its hash; `cargo jackioh spec check` is green with the new ruling.

## Size and risks

Hard: a design change across the server, a ruling and many tests (about 16 server files assume who sits first). Whether the first seat should be a coin at all is the owner's decision; Hearthstone tosses one. No engine rule changes, since Player 1 still goes first. The client already reads who goes first from the view.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40327788637)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Every 1v1 door seats P1/P2 by a coin drawn from the match or series seed on a new `{seed}:seats` stream, so a fixed seed set produces both seat orders and the same seed always seats the same way. A rematch swaps the previous match's seats instead of flipping a coin. A Conquest series draws its p1 by the same coin and keeps R335's game-number alternation relative to that p1. Seeded end-to-end specs pin seats through a new `seat` override beside R143's `seed`. A new ruling R1989000 amends R1453, R335, §9.5 and §9.12.

## Files to touch

| File | New/change | What changes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `crates/server/src/config.rs` | change | New `pub const SEAT_COIN_LABEL: &str = "seats"` beside the bot constants, with an R1989000 doc comment (rule 9). |
| `crates/server/src/api/queue.rs` | change | New `pub(crate) fn seat_coin_p1_first(seed: &str) -> bool` (`Rng::new(&format!("{seed}:{SEAT_COIN_LABEL}"), 0).int(2) == 0`: true means the precedence-first profile takes P1); coin ordering in `start_paired_match`, `start_paired_series`, `start_bot_match`, `kick_off_bot_match`, bot-series pairing; new `seat_override_of` plus `E2E_SEAT_BY_TICKET` map with host/older-ticket-wins precedence, forgotten with the seed. |
| `crates/server/src/actor/rooms.rs` | change | Coin ordering in `room_seats` and the Conquest-join `NewSeriesInput` sides; `HeldSeat` gains the seat override and `take_seed_for_room` returns it host-first; join response `"seat"` becomes the joiner's actual seat (today hardcoded `"p2"`). |
| `crates/server/src/api/rematch.rs` | change | `create_rematch` swaps: `finished.players.1` becomes P1, `.0` becomes P2; Bo1 decks, portraits and slots travel with the profile; All Random deals stay seat-keyed with each profile's lean looked up by its finished-match seat. |
| `crates/server/src/api/series_rules.rs` | change | Comments only: `NewSeriesInput.sides` index 0 is the coin-drawn series p1; `first_seat_of`/`game_seats` logic unchanged. |
| `crates/server/src/api/series.rs` | change | Comment only, if its `start_series` docs name older-ticket/host ordering. |
| `spec/09-architecture.md` | change | §9.5 seating sentences (queue pairs, rooms, rematch, fallback, Conquest) and §9.12 bot paragraph rewritten to the coin plus swap, citing `[[R1989000]]`. |
| `spec/rulings/R1453.md` | change | Replace the "player is always Player 1" paragraph with the coin; keep claim, bot-choice and ranking text. |
| `spec/rulings/R0335.md` | change | Series p1 is the coin winner, not the earlier queuer/host; alternation text stays. |
| `spec/rulings/R1989000.md` | new | The ruling: stream, doors covered, rematch swap, e2e override, Hearthstone coin as the undecided-decision basis. |
| `spec/11-rulings.md` | change | Append one paragraph for R1989000 in the file's pattern. |
| `spec/INDEX.md` | change | Regenerated by `cargo jackioh spec index`. |
| `crates/server/tests/api/queue.rs` | change | Amend older-ticket-is-P1 assertions to coin-derived expectations; add `r1989000` pair tests. |
| `crates/server/tests/actor/rooms.rs` | change | Amend host-is-P1 assertions; add `r1989000` room tests. |
| `crates/server/tests/api/rematch.rs` | change | Add `r1989000` swap tests (normal and double-or-nothing). |
| `crates/server/tests/api/bots.rs` | change | Amend person-is-P1 assertions; add `r1989000` bot-pairing tests. |
| `crates/server/tests/api/series.rs`, `series_rules.rs` | change | Amend series-p1 assertions; add `r1989000` coin-plus-alternation tests. |
| `crates/server/tests/api/e2e.rs` | change | Tests for the `seat` override (accepted in e2e, refused outside it). |
| `e2e/cypress/e2e/06-room-code.cy.ts`, `05-reconnect.cy.ts` | change | Send `seat: "p1"` on the host's create so each spec keeps the seats it was written for. |

Must not touch: `crates/engine`, `crates/ai`, `crates/cards`, `apps/web` (the client reads `seat` and the view), database migrations, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`.

Governing spec: §9.5, §9.12, R143 (override pattern), R335, R672 (double-or-nothing rides the same swap), R1341 (stream-label precedent), R1452–R1454.

## Steps

1. Add `SEAT_COIN_LABEL` to `crates/server/src/config.rs` with an R1989000 comment, mirroring `CODE_ALPHABET`'s shape.
2. In `crates/server/src/api/queue.rs`, add `seat_coin_p1_first` next to `new_seed`, importing `SEAT_COIN_LABEL` and `jackioh_engine::Rng` as the file already uses it for `{seed}:bot-deck`.
3. In `start_paired_match`, order the pair by `older_first`, then assign P1/P2 by the coin on the match seed; Bo1 frozen decks, portraits and slots travel with the profile, while All Random deals `dealt_deck(seed, "p1"/"p2", own lean)` to whoever holds each seat.
4. In `start_paired_series` and the bot-series pairing, order `NewSeriesSide`s by the coin on `seed_base` (sides index 0 is the coin winner); leave game seeds (`{seed_base}:{n}`), `first_seat_of` and `game_seats` untouched.
5. In `start_bot_match`, seat person/bot by the coin on the match seed; keep the bot's Bo1 deck pick on the profile-keyed `{seed}:bot-deck` stream. In `kick_off_bot_match`, seat grinder/opponent by the coin; keep `{seed}:bot-deck:{seat}` seat-keyed.
6. In `crates/server/src/actor/rooms.rs`, seat host/joiner by the coin in `room_seats` (deals and portraits stay seat-keyed, leans travel with the profile) and order the Conquest-join sides by the coin; report the joiner's real seat in the join response.
7. In `crates/server/src/api/rematch.rs`, swap seats in `create_rematch` (no coin): new P1 gets `finished.players.1` with that profile's deck, portrait, slots and lean; All Random redeals from the fresh seed keyed by new seat.
8. Add `seat_override_of` in `queue.rs` beside `seed_override_of`: optional `"seat": "p1"\|"p2"`, e2e-gated and refused elsewhere. Remember it per ticket (`E2E_SEAT_BY_TICKET`, forgotten with the seed on pair/cancel) and per room (`HeldSeat`, host wins over joiner). At each door, a honored override pins the requester's seat and skips the coin; precedence conflicts resolve older-ticket/host first, the other profile taking the free seat.
9. Write `spec/rulings/R1989000.md` (front matter `id`, `title`, `cards`, `proven_in` listing the five test files), amend R1453, R335, §9.5, §9.12 and `spec/11-rulings.md`, then run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
10. Update the server tests: replace hardcoded seat expectations with coin-derived ones (compute via `seat_coin_p1_first` on the row's seed), keep coverage; add `r1989000` tests per file.
11. Update the two e2e specs to send the `seat` override; keep every other assertion.

## Tests

- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::queue::r1989000` — fixed seed set yields both orders; same seed re-runs seat identically; override pins the seat.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server actor::rooms::r1989000` — host/joiner coin plus override.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::bots::r1989000` — person/bot coin over fixed seeds.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::rematch::r1989000` — rematch and double-or-nothing seat previous P2 as P1, decks travelling with profiles.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::series::r1989000` and `api::series_rules::r1989000` — game 1 follows the coin, games still alternate p1/p2/p1.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::e2e::` — override refused outside e2e mode.
- `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec index`, `cargo jackioh spec check`. The edited Cypress specs are covered by CI's e2e smoke.

## Done when

- [ ] Each door (queue pair, room, bot pairing, grind kickoff, series start) seats by the coin; fixed seeds show both orders and replay identically.
- [ ] Rematches (including double-or-nothing) swap seats with decks following profiles.
- [ ] Conquest game 1 follows the coin and games alternate; R335's amended tests pass.
- [ ] Seeded e2e specs pin seats via the override and need no other change.
- [ ] `spec check` is green with the new ruling; fmt, clippy and the touched server tests pass.

## Risks

- Determinism: the coin reads only the match/series seed at cursor 0 (`int(2)`), never match state, time or ticket ids; All Random deck and emote streams stay seat-keyed so replays fold unchanged. Guard by asserting equal seats across two runs of the same seed in tests.
- Seat-keyed versus profile-keyed streams must not mix: `{seed}:bot-deck` (person-vs-bot) travels with the bot, `{seed}:bot-deck:{seat}` and `{seed}:p1-deck` stay with the seat. Mixing them would redeal bot decks.
- Hardcoded-seat tests are numerous; every updated expectation must derive from the coin, never be deleted or weakened.
- The join response's `"seat"` field now varies; the web client already consumes it dynamically, so no `apps/web` change is needed.

## Open questions

None blocking. One judgment call recorded: the override is a per-requester `"seat": "p1"|"p2"` pin with older-ticket/host precedence, mirroring the seed override, rather than a full seat-order field — rejected as heavier than any spec needs.
```

3. In `start_paired_match`, order the pair by `older_first`, then assign P1/P2 by the coin on the match seed; Bo1 frozen decks, portraits and slots travel with the profile, while All Random deals `dealt_deck(seed, "p1"/"p2", own lean)` to whoever holds each seat.
4. In `start_paired_series` and the bot-series pairing, order `NewSeriesSide`s by the coin on `seed_base` (sides index 0 is the coin winner); leave game seeds (`{seed_base}:{n}`), `first_seat_of` and `game_seats` untouched.

- `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::bots::r1989000` — person/bot coin over fixed seeds.

- [ ] Each door (queue pair, room, bot pairing, grind kickoff, series start) seats by the coin; fixed seeds show both orders and replay identically.
- [ ] Rematches (including double-or-nothing) swap seats with decks following profiles.
- [ ] Conquest game 1 follows the coin and games alternate; R335's amended tests pass.
- [ ] Seeded e2e specs pin seats via the override and need no other change.
- [ ] `spec check` is green with the new ruling; fmt, clippy and the touched server tests pass.

- Determinism: the coin reads only the match/series seed at cursor 0 (`int(2)`), never match state, time or ticket ids; All Random deck and emote streams stay seat-keyed so replays fold unchanged. Guard by asserting equal seats across two runs of the same seed in tests.

- Hardcoded-seat tests are numerous; every updated expectation must derive from the coin, never be deleted or weakened.
- The join response's `"seat"` field now varies; the web client already consumes it dynamically, so no `apps/web` change is needed.

None blocking. One judgment call recorded: the override is a per-requester `"seat": "p1"|"p2"` pin with older-ticket/host precedence, mirroring the seed override, rather than a full seat-order field — rejected as heavier than any spec needs.
